entities.summary: Kevin Dwayne Henderson is a professional basketball player. He played college basketball for the Cal State Fullerton Titans and played for the Golden State Warriors and Cleveland Cavaliers in a two-season NBA career. In 22 games, he averaged 10.7 minutes and 3.0 points per game.
